title: Bounded constructible preservation for native Weil pullback and ordinary direct image
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes. Use $D(\mathcal W_X)$, $D(\mathcal W_Y)$ and their bounded constructible full subcategories $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)$, $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0)$ from [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. The actual ambient termwise pullback and right-derived ordinary direct image preserve these subcategories: for every $L\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0)$ and $K\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)$,
$$f^*L\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0),\qquad Rf_*K\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0).$$
Their restrictions are the actual functors `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex.upperStar f₀` and `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex.derivedLowerStar f₀`. In particular these conclusions assert both boundedness and constructibility of every cohomology sheaf for each displayed ambient object.

source.place: Clauses 1 and 3, native derived-Weil realization; live lean/WeilConjectures/WeilSheaf/Category.lean:472-480 (pullback restriction and preservation) and LowerStar.lean:144-156, 171-179 (AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex.objectProperty_rightDerivedLowerStar and its restriction). These live declarations specify the assertion in this model; no equivalence with the geometric coefficient categories is presumed.

proof.text: For an ambient derived Weil complex L satisfying the object predicate, form the full-subcategory object (L,hL). Apply the existing restricted pullback WeilComplex.upperStar f of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. By its actual liftFullSubcategory construction its underlying object is the ambient termwise pullback of L. The membership witness of this object is the required bounded constructibility assertion. This reuses the existing native pullback proof; no coefficient realization is required.

Apply the existing native theorem WeilComplex.objectProperty_rightDerivedLowerStar f to K and hK. Its hypotheses are satisfied: separatedness of f implies quasi-separatedness, and all finite-type and quasi-compactness hypotheses are explicitly assumed. This is the preservation witness used by the actual restricted functor WeilComplex.derivedLowerStar f of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], whose source proof uses native derived-forgetting and bounded devissage. No assertion of transitive sorry-freeness is made.

Unfold the two actual restricted functors of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Each is liftFullSubcategory of the displayed ambient functor. Its composite with the target inclusion is definitionally equal to the source inclusion followed by the ambient functor: the objects and morphisms coincide. Both equalities are rfl in Lean.

lean.statement: theorem native_pullback_star_preservation (k₀ : Type u) [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] : (∀ L : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l Y), objectProperty k₀ l Y L → objectProperty k₀ l X ((ProEtaleWeilSheaf.upperStar k₀ l f).mapDerivedCategory.obj L)) ∧ (∀ K : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X), objectProperty k₀ l X K → objectProperty k₀ l Y ((ProEtaleWeilSheaf.lowerStar k₀ l f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K)) ∧ (upperStar (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f ⋙ (objectProperty k₀ l X).ι = (objectProperty k₀ l Y).ι ⋙ (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.upperStar k₀ l f).mapDerivedCategory) ∧ (derivedLowerStar (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f ⋙ (objectProperty k₀ l Y).ι = (objectProperty k₀ l X).ι ⋙ (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.lowerStar k₀ l f).rightDerivedFunctor)
